agent:
  execution_path: claude_code_direct

    Model selection: sonnet is explicit because syntax-preserving transformation design and unsafe-construct classification require non-trivial judgment; this is not pure lookup work suitable for haiku.
    A parser-based, reviewable, idempotent codemod must exist before repository-wide
    import and qualified-name changes are applied.

  executor:
    kind: agent_native
    implementation: runtime.logger.ExecutionLogger
  journal:
    path: plans_internal/refactor_repo/execution/P02/execution_log.jsonl
    schema: schemas/execution_log.schema.v2.json
    format: jsonl
    write_mode: append_only
  action_protocol:
    before_action: append_act_started
    after_success: append_act_completed_closing_start
    after_failure: append_exec_closing_start
  restart:
    detection: compute_unclosed_starts
    no_journal: fresh_start
    closed_action: reuse_if_inputs_unchanged
    unclosed_action: resume_or_idempotently_repeat
  completion_gate:
    require_valid_journal: true
    require_zero_unclosed_starts: true
    require_all_tests_pass: true
    require_authorized_paths_only: true

goal: >-
  After P00A activates this prompt in the inventory-resolved manifest, implement a version-pinned LibCST-based transformation from the
  production import root runtime to curriculum_factory for Python imports and qualified
  names. Provide before/after fixtures for aliases, multiline forms, comments, strings,
  dynamic and ambiguous references, and already-migrated input; add deterministic
  dry-run diff, apply mode, explicit non-targets, diagnostics, and residual-reference
  postconditions. Do not apply it to live production/tests, edit prose or structured
  configuration, move files, or perform broad regex replacement. Stop on any construct
  that cannot be classified safely. Rollback is removal/reversion of the authorized
  codemod assets followed by the unchanged P00 inventory check. Passing P02 unblocks P03 only after P01 passes. Structured TOML/JSON/YAML
  changes are owned separately by P02S.

tests:
  - description: Resolved manifest grants exact non-overlapping mutation ownership
    check: >-
      Load prompts/resolved/prompt_manifest.resolved.v1.yaml, verify it activates this
      exact prompt version, expand its path plus structured-key, symbol, transformation-
      class, move-operation, or external-target selectors, and compare those units with
      the planned and final diff/action journal plus every other active prompt's units.
    expected: >-
      Every intended and actual mutation unit is owned by this prompt exactly once; no
      unit is unowned, shared, borrowed from a successor, or merely covered by a broader
      authorized path.

  - description: Fixture matrix covers every required transformation class
    check: >-
      Enumerate fixture metadata and assert cases for aliased and multiline imports,
      from-imports, module-qualified names, preserved comments/formatting, strings,
      dynamic imports, ambiguous references, and already curriculum_factory input.
    expected: >-
      Every required class has a named expected transformation or a named diagnostic;
      comments and ordinary strings are not silently rewritten.

  - description: Dry-run is deterministic, reviewable, and write-free
    check: >-
      Snapshot fixture bytes, run dry-run twice with the pinned tool version and stable
      ordering, compare emitted unified diffs and diagnostics, then compare the files
      with the snapshot.
    expected: >-
      Dry-run output is byte-identical, names every candidate/skip/failure, and changes
      no input file.

  - description: Apply mode produces exact fixtures and is idempotent
    check: >-
      Apply the codemod to disposable fixture copies, compare with expected outputs,
      then apply it a second time and capture the resulting diff and exit status.
    expected: The first result matches exactly and the second application is an empty change.

  - description: Unsafe and residual references fail closed
    check: >-
      Exercise dynamic import strings, computed module names, malformed Python, mixed
      old/new qualified names, and configured post-scan roots including an unexpected
      new curriculum_factory reference.
    expected: >-
      Unsafe constructs produce actionable nonzero diagnostics; allowed non-targets are
      reported; old residuals and unexpected new references cannot pass silently.

  - description: Live repository rehearsal is dry-run only
    check: >-
      Run the codemod in dry-run mode against the P00-classified Python surface and
      compare candidates/diagnostics with P00 AST and lexical inventories plus git status.
    expected: >-
      Candidate coverage reconciles with P00, every mismatch is explained, and no live
      repository file outside authorized paths changes.

  - description: Independent Codex QA accepts the P02 checkpoint
    check: >-
      Gate a versioned P02 checkpoint report with qa-gate-codex-run using the shared
      checkpoint criteria and this prompt, fixture evidence, dry-run evidence, and
      specification v8 as grounding; use threshold blocker, at most five iterations,
      and run verify.
    expected: The witnessed verify result is QA_PASSED and identifies the passing artifact.
    verifier:
      execution_path: codex_plugin
      invokes:
        type: skill
        skill: qa-gate-codex-run
      reasoning: Codemod safety cannot be self-certified by its author.

loop:
  steps:
    - Apply restart handling and verify P00/P00A checkpoints, resolved activation, and pinned parser dependency.
    - Define fixture metadata and explicit targets/non-targets before implementation.
    - Implement dry-run, diagnostics, apply mode, and residual postconditions.
    - Run fixtures, determinism, idempotence, failure, and live dry-run rehearsal tests.
    - Record the rollback checkpoint and complete the independent QA protocol.
    - Apply completion gates and identify P03 as successor contingent on P01.
  stopping_condition: >-
    Stop successfully only when all seven tests pass, unsafe constructs fail closed,
    live rehearsal is write-free, scope/journal gates pass, and QA verify says QA_PASSED.
  resume_check: >-
    Compare the parser version, fixture digests, codemod digest, and P00 inventory digest
    before reusing any closed action; rerun when any input differs.
  escalation: >-
    On any unclassifiable syntax or two repeated failures, stop and report the smallest
    additional fixture or transformation rule needed; never fall back to broad regex.
  retry_policy:
    auto_retry: [tool-error, partial-run]
    requires_fix: [missing-input, bad-input, wrong-output, other]
